subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "The execution of the REWRITE statement causes the I-O status value in the rewrite file connector to be updated as indicated in 9.1.13, I-O status." Every connector Rewrite path ends in `return Status = ...` (00/02/21/22/23/43/44/49/71, 30 for a non-seekable stream), RewriteShared adds 51/52 and the pre-flight lock status, and both emitters store the connector status into the FILE STATUS item (EmitStoreFileStatus) after every REWRITE.
